question: Which committee demanded the “Bill of Rights” in 1928?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Motilal Nehru committee__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Motilal Nehru is the **chairman** of the **Nehru committee.**
 
• Nehru Report was released by** Motilal Nehru in 1928.**
 
• The members who signed the report were **Ali Imam**, **Tej Bahadur Sapru**, **Mangal Singh**, **M S Aney**, **Subhas Chandra Bose**, **Shuaib Qureshi**, and **G R Pradhan**. 
 
• This was the **first major** attempt by **Indians to draft a constitution** for themselves.
 
• **Recommendations of the Nehru Report:**
 
 
• **Dominion status**
 
• Rejection of separate electorates.
 
• **Linguistic provinces.**
 
• **Nineteen fundamental rights including equal rights for women.**
 
• **Full protection to the cultural and religious interests of Muslims.**
 
• Complete dissociation of religion from the state.
